why: Integrator for the mechanical slices E4 to E25 of the Effect-check sweep, in next/ and our tooling, on fabrikalfa/effect-mechanical. 22 slice branches merged with --no-ff in order, then origin/main. Seven merges had code conflicts (E6 ten Schema.TaggedError lines, E9 mutbox.ts, E11 two tests, E20 twin.ts, E21 records.ts and sizecap.ts, main's PullRequestsTest.ts); each kept both sides' changes. The slices' lock entries are folded into one overrides entry per distinct folder set in each package's own tsconfig, by a scratch script; nothing in tsconfig.base.json. The recount (effect-tsgo diagnostics with the 22 checks at error on all 13 projects, then pnpm typecheck as the proof) found 57 hits inside the locks that the slices had not met: 1 E18 left (ChildrenLedger.ts:405, a hand edit to Effect.filterMapOrFail), 50 in .agents files the project reaches only by import (37 by the checker's quick fix, 13 brand arguments by a scratch line edit), 2 in oxlint-plugins that main brought (quick fix), 1 in vitest outside E6's row (hand edit, and vitest now locks the check), plus the .github/ci and oxlint-plugins tsconfigs, whose merged plugin block had landed as a second compilerOptions key. One behavior bug from E4 was found by the laws: the telemetry sink's checked hour starts at -Infinity, which E4's Schema.Finite refused; it is now Schema.Finite or -Infinity, with no ignore line. 313 hits of the 22 checks stay outside the locks: 79 in files of pull request 1366, 234 in the after-1366 slices' folders (E61 to E74).

plants.law: L1: a hit in a locked folder fails the typecheck

plants.law: L1 by hand: the glob is what holds it
